instructions.question: Does this comment show sincere approval (positive), explicit hostility or despair (negative), or neither (neutral)?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default: plain questions, discrepancies, forecasts, mild worry, mask or lockdown advice, complaints without insult, tags, ads and city-ranking jokes. Negative needs a trigger: a curse, an insult word, blame of the government or parties, a lying claim, mockery of the Institute's competence, sarcastic praise, or a horror or despair word (tmer, katastrofe, ma keq). Positive covers sincere thanks, praise, blessings, encouragement and clear relief at falling cases or recoveries, even alongside criticism. A thanks that only prefaces a question is neutral.

neutral.what: The default: questions, doubts, discrepancies, forecasts, mild worry, advice, complaints without insult, tags, jokes.
examples: Kta a jon me teste a veq me sy t'testum? (Are these with tests or just tested by eye?)
Qito dy jav jon kritike! (These two weeks are critical!)
Dedë Valdrin ma gjall ma gjall (Dedë Valdrin, faster, faster)
neutral.cues: tagged names, pse (why), a jon (are they), duhet (should), karantin (quarantine), maska (masks), per marakli (worth worrying about), hahaha
neutral.not_for: A curse, insult, government blame, horror word or ridicule of the Institute's competence makes it negative.

positive.what: Sincere thanks or praise, blessings, congratulations, encouragement, relief at falling cases or recoveries.
examples: Lakorja paska fillu me ra (The curve has started to fall)
Hallall ju koft si ju ne kosov qe pi sheroni  pacientet nga Covid 19 (Well done to you in Kosovo for curing patients)
Ta mundim kete pandemi te gjithe se bashku (Let's beat this pandemic all together)
positive.cues: ju lumt (well done), hallall, bravo, respekt (respect), flm (thanks), perhajr (congratulations), ka ra numri (number fell), te sherum (recovered), Zoti na ruajt (God protect us)
positive.not_for: Cheering cities ('ma gjall' (faster), 'forza peja'), tags, ads and 'edhe pak e iku' (almost gone) are neutral. Sarcastic praise is negative.

negative.what: Curses, insults, blaming the government, lying claims, ridicule of the Institute, sarcastic praise, horror or despair.
examples: Qeveria koti ika fajet (The Kurti government is to blame)
183 a 195 se ju ka hup topi diçka kohëve të fundit (183 or 195, you've lost the plot lately)
Tmerrshem (Horrible)
Mashalla ka hi qeveria e re me kom te mire gjdo dite ma shum raste (Mashallah, the new government came in lucky, more cases daily)
negative.cues: fajet (to blame), rren (lie), injorant (ignorant), palaqo/bosa/huti (fool), qifsha (vulgar), tmer (horror), katastrof (catastrophe), ma keq (worse), bomb, ZEZA (disaster)
negative.not_for: Neutral questions about numbers, without ridicule or a lying claim, are neutral.
